voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, no tempo change

lines.text: Mula nang mamatay si Lola, dinadalaw niya ako sa panaginip. Pero 'yung huling dalaw... hindi na siya.
lines.beat_before: hook: the dream: someone seated at the foot of my bed, back to me; her head comes round in snaps, face in shadow

lines.text: Unang beses, nakaupo siya sa paanan ng kama ko. "Huwag kang lalabas bukas, apo."
lines.beat_before: the first dream: Lola at the foot of the bed, facing me, the rosary in her hands

lines.text: Hindi ako lumabas. Kinabukasan, hanggang dibdib ang baha sa kanto. Mula noon, lagi na siyang nagbabantay.
lines.beat_before: the house by day: the street outside the window, flooded chest-deep; then Lola in my doorway at night, watching

lines.text: Kagabi, nandoon ulit siya sa paanan ng kama. Pero nakatalikod siya sa akin.
lines.beat_before: the last dream: the foot of the bed, a grey-haired woman, her back to me

lines.text: "Apo, pagbuksan mo ako ng pinto. Malamig dito sa labas."
lines.beat_before: the house: the dark sala, the front door; the knob turns, a shadow under it

lines.text: Lumapit ako. Unang humarap ang ulo niya, bago ang katawan. Rosaryo ni Lola. Pero ibang mukha.
lines.beat_before: the dream: I come closer; her head turns round first, the body after; the rosary; not her face

lines.text: Nagising ako. Bukas ang pinto sa sala. Hindi ko binuksan 'yon.
lines.beat_before: the house: I wake; the sala, the front door open on the rain

lines.text: At sa paanan ng kama ko, lubog pa ang kutson. Parang may nakaupo pa rin.
lines.beat_before: my bed: the dent at its foot; then she is sitting there, in the house, and her head snaps to the lens
